description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the JsonWebToken interface, specifically handling standard JSON Web Tokens. It provides static methods to create instances from authorization headers or token strings, and overrides methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonWebToken
classes.description: Immutable implementation of JsonWebToken for standard JWTs, extending AbstractJsonWebToken, and providing methods for creating instances from authorization strings or tokens.

methods.name: fromAuthorization
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableJsonWebToken instance from an authorization header string.

methods.name: fromToken
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableJsonWebToken instance from a token string.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the list of authorization subjects extracted from the token.
